scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p='../public_html/.htaccess';if(fs.existsSync(p)){let c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!c.includes('RewriteEngine On')){c=c.replace('RewriteRule',`RewriteEngine On\nRewriteRule`);fs.writeFileSync(p,c);console.log('Patched .htaccess');}}" 2>/dev/null || true
